overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its monthly First Fridays Words and Music program, featuring an interview with former Medford Poet Laureate Terry Carter and a gospel musical performance by Dr. Renee Haywood and Rayma Haywood.

items.title: Interview with Terry Carter
items.summary: Ilene Lerner interviewed Medford Poet Laureate Terry Carter about his background, literary influences, gentrification in West Medford, and local history, accompanied by readings of his poetry.

items.title: Community Center Announcements
items.summary: Terry Carter shared center updates regarding senior lunches, recent fundraising campaigns, upcoming Martin Luther King Jr. Day events, and fitness classes.

items.title: Musical Performance by Renee and Rayma Haywood
items.summary: Dr. Renee Haywood and Rayma Haywood performed a musical set of gospel and holiday songs.
